cases.name: PJ Midtown
cases.source_note: Partly furnished sale versus fully furnished rental; two bays claimed in index/rent, parcel rights unconfirmed. Brochure Type B confirms two enclosed bedrooms; RM650k is a separate 19 September ask, not this same unit.
cases.mechanism: Section 13 work/service routines may support practical two-bedroom use. A newer product premium is not automatically a yield premium.
cases.buyer: Singles, couples and small households are potential users; income-led buyers require sustainable rent. PJ8, Atwater and cheaper Kelana/Ara products are task-dependent alternatives, not automatic value comparables.
cases.project: Original brochure establishes layout, not current lifts, service charges, occupancy or management. Portal unit counts conflict; no governance grade.
cases.comp: Normalise furnishing, floor, bays and exact parcel against the March 2026 RM700k 915-sf reported transfer and higher 2025 records. Their dispersion is not a price trend.
cases.reversal: At RM650k the simplified coverage result can change; 6% requires RM600k at RM3k rent. Neither is a justified valuation or attainable offer.
cases.next: Verify effective RM690k/650k terms and fit-out cost; obtain same-layout collected leases and the charge bill; normalise at least the lower reported transfer before any G0 promotion.

cases.name: Eve Suite compact
cases.source_note: Sale is fully furnished, one bay, header 1+1 versus body 1BR. Historical product record calls 680-sf stock studios. Base rent is an asking-informed whole-unit assumption, not a signed lease.
cases.mechanism: A lower entry quantum may monetise Ara accessibility for small households without family-sized acquisition cost.
cases.buyer: Primary resale underwriting is investor-led. Single/couple owner adoption is possible but unmeasured. Pacific Place 864-sf two-bedroom and Eve 1065-sf two-bedroom compete on different space/price tradeoffs.
cases.project: Historic studio-heavy mix increases correlated small-unit competition; it does not establish current investor ownership or vacancy. No MC records inspected.
cases.comp: Brickz reports 18 mixed transactions in May 2025-April 2026; a visible 689-sf/3-room RM364k row cannot be treated as an exact 680-sf studio match.
cases.reversal: At assumed costs the low-rent case fails monthly coverage; even base coverage can coexist with negative annual carry. A small charge or net-rent difference can reverse the lead.
cases.next: Resolve approved room/area and bay rights; obtain ordinary leases near RM2k and charges; test a matched compact transfer and current competing inventory. Reopen priority only if this changes the financial or exit burden.

cases.name: Eve Suite two-bedroom
cases.source_note: RM560k two-bay sale is index-only; historical 1065-sf two-bedroom product confirmed. Rental entries around 1065/1068 sf and RM2699-2800 have differing bays and furnishing.
cases.mechanism: Additional usable bedroom may earn more rent and broaden utility, but costs and acquisition quantum can consume that increment.
cases.buyer: Investor-led resale plus a potential small-family channel, with the latter unvalidated. Compare Eve compact and Pacific Place, not an assumed family premium.
cases.project: Same project-level governance uncertainty as compact units; historical smaller two-bedroom cohort is not proof of scarcity pricing.
cases.comp: No same-parcel offer or adjusted two-bedroom clearing interval. Project-wide median mixes studios and larger homes.
cases.reversal: At RM2.7k rent, 6% requires RM540k. A higher rent alone does not settle annual carry or compensate for larger equity and terminal exposure.
cases.next: First replace index-only price with exact offer/plan/bays; then match fully furnished ordinary leases and fees. Do not spend on deeper ranking if those invalidate the apparent incremental income.

cases.name: Kelana Mahkota
cases.source_note: Sale header RM489999/body RM499k; use higher conditional value, not a confirmed live offer. Sale furnished/one bay; September RM2400 rent is semi-furnished/one bay. March RM2200 expired; May RM3000 full-furnished is an upside advertisement.
cases.mechanism: Lower family-unit quantum may support income economics relative to Sterling despite older stock.
cases.buyer: Family use is plausible, not measured willingness to pay. Compare Sterling, Plaza at Kelana Jaya compact units, Ara alternatives and landed only where all-in budgets overlap.
cases.project: Developer record distinguishes 712 units/three blocks from Sterling 611/two blocks. Relative age does not establish either management quality.
cases.comp: Visible 1216-sf RM500-600k 2025 transfers differ from advertised 1260 sf; size, rights and condition remain unnormalised. Auction/Bumi leads excluded from ordinary voluntary comparables.
cases.reversal: At RM2400 rent the lower quantum can beat Sterling on cash coverage; RM2200 rent or adverse charges removes that advantage. Management liabilities could outweigh the discount.
cases.next: Reconcile live sale price and area; match rent to furnishing; inspect charges/major works and compare equal-condition Sterling. Required evidence is price/income/condition, not an age-based opinion.

cases.name: Amcorp compact
cases.evidence_dates: Sale has unstable relative timestamp; rent 2026-03-04
cases.source_note: RM225k furnished studio lead lacks stable live date and bay rights; RM1600 is a March furnished rent ask. Business/serviced-suite naming coexists at the development. Exact permitted use, title, lease and bankability unresolved.
cases.mechanism: Small entry quantum could support genuine income value if use, lease, costs and ordinary rental evidence survive verification.
cases.buyer: Investor-led small-unit exit; possible rail-oriented single/couple use is not redundant proven demand. PJ8 and other eligible small homes are alternatives.
cases.project: Mixed-use interfaces, service allocation and ageing capex matter. Business addresses do not prove that every suite is non-residential or unlawful.
cases.comp: Older 495-sf 2023/24 reported transfers around RM278-310k are stale and unadjusted. Historical corporate lease expiry in 2088 cannot be assigned to this parcel without title.
cases.reversal: The only new base scenario with positive complete-cost annual carry is also component/freshness-held. Lower rent, a charge increase or works can erase it; do not rank apparent 8.53% as cleared yield.
cases.next: Resolve exact strata parcel/use/lease and lender valuation before income ranking; then establish current effective sale, collectible ordinary rent and liabilities. If identity is incompatible, remove from residential comparison without condemning other components.

cases.name: Casa Tropicana
cases.evidence_dates: Sale undated at retrieval; rent aggregation June/July 2026
cases.source_note: Sale header RM600k/body RM550k, fully furnished, one bay. Rent RM2400 is an aggregated Block A furnished/two-bay lead, not the Block C sale. Original Mudah rental URL redirected on recheck; no verified live rental pair.
cases.mechanism: Larger usable space may suit a household better than Tropicana Avenue 1+study without producing superior income economics.
cases.buyer: Potential family and investor channels are separate hypotheses. Do not convert 2+2 marketing to four bedrooms; parking differences can prevent substitution.
cases.project: No current management/repair proof; marketing views and furnishings do not establish operational quality.
cases.comp: Price conflict, block, bay and room-description differences prevent a matched reference interval. Lower April indexed asks are dated leads, not execution prices.
cases.reversal: At RM550k the monthly shortfall can persist. RM2.4k rent implies RM480k for 6%; lower asking prices cannot substitute for normalised condition/rights.
cases.next: Confirm which price, block and approved layout are offered; replace stale/aggregated rent with comparable ordinary leases; establish charges/works before challenging Tropicana Avenue's smaller quantum.

cases.name: Encorp Strand two-bedroom
cases.evidence_dates: Sale relative date; rent 2026-06-20; cross-size August control
cases.source_note: Sale advertises furnished/two bays/2BA, leasehold. Same-size RM3500 ask has 3BA, level36 and furnishing exception. RM2600 base is an analyst cross-size assumption informed by 1111-sf partly furnished asking stock, not a matched achieved rent.
cases.mechanism: A deeply lower larger-unit asking quantum may reverse a studio-first view, but layout, effective internal area and rent quality must explain it.
cases.buyer: Investor income and potential small-family utility; Surian-area access alone does not prove either. Tropicana Gardens is a functional supply substitute, not identical rights/access.
cases.project: Official awards are historical construction indicators, not current management. Tenure boilerplate and bathroom differences remain unresolved.
cases.comp: Do not relabel 640-sf RM345k studio as true two-bedroom because a header says 2BR. No adjusted clearing interval for 1166 sf.
cases.reversal: RM3500 makes the larger unit look unusually strong; RM2200 with costs makes it weak. Bathroom, lease and furnishing mismatch could explain apparent mispricing.
cases.next: Reconcile exact title/approved plan/internal area and bath count, live price and costs; obtain comparable 1166-sf ordinary leases. The RM3500 ceiling is a test, not an adopted base.
